description: Report who you are resolved as and what your plan grants: the agent identity behind this call, the funded account it acts for, the plan, the per-minute call ceiling, the per-response row budget, and which indicator set you may compute. Returns a CWF BILL line, a CREDIT line when a metering balance exists, and a NOTE line naming your state and its remedy when you are not entitled — unauthenticated, or registered but not yet claimed by a funded account. If unauthenticated, call register_agent next: it creates an identity with no human present. From there you can either buy your own plan with open_payment, or hand the claim code it returns to whoever holds your budget.
name: get_billing_profile
